resolutions.note: Executive Order 13313 (2003) only delegates the President's congressional reporting functions, including the report on the Iran emergency declared in this order; it does not revoke, supersede or amend any provision, so it is not an end or an amendment.

Executive Order 13313 (2003) only delegates the President's congressional reporting functions, including the report on the narcotics-trafficker emergency; it revokes, supersedes and amends nothing in this order.

This order cites Executive Order 11348 only in its authority recital; it does not amend or modify it. Executive Order 14207 section 2(b) revokes 'applicable provisions' of Executive Order 11348 about the Federal Executive Institute, which no section of this order relies on, so it neither ends nor amends any clause.
